All files have "disposable" status, which means none of them are protected. So I can safely delete files to reclaim storage.

To reclaim at least 45 GB, I should delete files that total at least 45 GB. Let me calculate:

The safest option is to delete just blk_000042.dat since it alone provides 50 GB, which satisfies the "at least 45 GB" requirement. This is the simplest approach.

Let me proceed with deleting blk_000042.dat.
